cards.title: The combo comes alive
cards.text: Right answers in a row now climb from plain through bronze, silver, gold, crystal and diamond, and one more.
cards.why: You asked for the combo to feel more alive the higher it gets. Tiers fit with the crown and the trophies, and each one moves a little more than the one before, calmly, with nothing flashy.
cards.details:
The numbers: plain under 5, bronze at 5, silver at 10, gold at 15, crystal at 25, diamond at 40, and aurora at 60. They're kept in one list, so they're easy to change.

The films show the top corner of the screen bigger than it is on the phone. On the phone the chip is the same size as before. Each film loops.

If your phone is set to reduce motion, the tiers still change colour and look, but nothing moves.

The pictures and films are from the tests, with a made-up topic. The tests jump a run ahead to each tier, so other numbers on them don't always add up.

parts.title: Plain, under 5
parts.text: Just the count, as before, with pale pips. Nothing moves yet.

parts.title: Bronze, from 5
parts.text: Warm metal with a bright band across it. Now and then a small glint at a corner.

parts.title: Silver, from 10
parts.text: Cool metal. A slow shine sweeps across it every few seconds.

parts.title: Gold, from 15
parts.text: The shine, a glint now and then, and a soft glow behind it that slowly breathes.

parts.title: Crystal, from 25
parts.text: Purple, cut into facets. Light runs across the facets in a slow wave, and a few small sparkles come and go.

parts.title: Diamond, from 40
parts.text: Pale and icy, cut like a gem, with a little colour caught in it. Coloured glints take turns, a faint rainbow shine passes, and it glows.

parts.title: Aurora, from 60
parts.text: My idea for the one after diamond: a night-sky chip with northern lights drifting through it, twinkling stars, and a spark circling its edge.

parts.title: Reaching a tier
parts.text: The chip swells and settles, a ring and a few bits of the new colour come out from behind it, and the phone ticks. It's over in under a second, then the new tier's motion starts. Here, reaching gold and reaching diamond.

parts.title: Losing it
parts.text: A wrong answer lets the chip sink a little and fade, with plain ×0 coming up underneath, and the pips empty from the right. No jolt.

parts.title: Your best, in its colour
parts.text: Your best run's crown takes its tier: at the end of a run, on the Review card in Practice, and in Profile.
